title: 第19章 会不会是末日到了第20章 超乎想象
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
“别愣着啦，赶紧拍视频发到朋友圈和网上啊，绝对能够吸粉无数的！”
……
旅行团中的其他人这时也注意到空中的奇景，并纷纷拿出设备记录下这段不可思议的经历。
随后不久，这片紫雾蔓延得越来越大，几乎覆盖了三千里范围。
相对于实际景象传播速度来说，消息在网上传播得更快。
这段有关自然异象的小视频刚发布至自媒体平台，就得到了广泛转发关注。
不到十分钟之内点击量便破了几千次。
大多数网民们一致评价：肯定是合成剪辑的虚假内容！
“明显假货啦，这样的天气根本不存在好吧。”
“真要有此等场面，老子立刻死在这里！”
“明知道造假你也转播？制作者的技术也太高超了，看着跟真的一模一样！”
“小伙子有没有兴趣到我公司工作？年薪至少50万起价哦。”
……
面对网友们的统一否定态度，原本兴奋不已打算分享这一奇妙时刻给大家看到的人们陷入了困惑状态之中。
但这也不怪众人怀疑，毕竟如果不是亲身经历了一番，恐怕谁都觉得这是不可能发生的事情。
与此同时，空中那紫色的光芒更加浓郁了，就像古老神话中的仙人飞升场景一般壮观。
“有了！
我们可以直播这场现象让大家一起观看呀！”
旅行团中的一个小姑娘大声提议道，随即众人立即行动起来。
在这个人人都可以开启在线视频共享的时代里，任何人都能在个人账号上进行直播展示真实情况。

通过这样形式直接证明事实的存在性显然更具说服力。
“大家好，我们现在位于黑连山上，刚才突然出现了一个惊人的自然现象，真是太神奇了，请大家看这里……”
直播间里的观看人数正以惊人的速度增长。
观众数量已经达到了平台有史以来的最高点！
评论区也是炸开了锅！
“我的天啊！
这世界居然真有这种异象！”
“你们瞧见东边那片紫色雾气了吗？是不是像条龙？”
“我看到了一个麒麟的样子！”
“我是不是眼花了，里面好像闪过一个人影！”
“简直不敢相信！
得让家里的长辈们看看这奇迹，说不定还能恢复健康！”
……
正当人们被紫色光芒吸引时，新的消息在网络上再次引起轩然大波。
华夏新闻社报道：华国南方沙漠上方出现了一座巨大的宫殿虚影，长达数百公里。
南古城媒体则说：塔业寺上空出现了数以百计的佛祖光影，这是不是意味着世界将要沐浴在佛教的光明中？
东康娱乐发布了一段视频，在海边捕捉到了美妙的人鱼歌声，据说能治愈疾病！
……
面对这些不可思议的事情，网友们经历了一阵狂热之后，竟然难得达成一致地安静下来。
并不是大家不想表达自己的想法，而是整个事件已经让他们感到非常茫然。

他们第一次如此希望这一切都是假的，但是所有证据却显示，这一切真的发生了。
然而，当新的一批视频开始在网上流传时，网友们的麻木心态彻底瓦解。
这次不仅是中国国内的信息，在许多国外媒体上也都能见到类似的报道。
content_en:
"Don't be stunned. Hurry up and take a video and post it on Moments and online. It will definitely attract countless fans!"
…
Others in the tour group also noticed the strange scene in the sky and took out their devices to record this incredible experience.
Soon afterwards, the purple mist spread larger and larger, covering almost three thousand miles.
相对于实际景象传播速度来说，消息在网上传播得更快。
This short video about natural phenomena has been widely forwarded and paid attention to as soon as it was posted on the self-media platform.
In less than ten minutes, the number of hits exceeded thousands.
Most netizens unanimously commented: It must be fake content that was synthesized and edited!
"It's obviously fake. Such weather doesn't exist at all."
"If such a scene really happens, I will die here immediately!"
“明知道造假你也转播？制作者的技术也太高超了，看着跟真的一模一样！”
"Young man, are you interested in working in our company? The annual salary starts at least 500,000 yuan."
…
Faced with the unanimous negative attitude of netizens, people who were originally excited and planned to share this wonderful moment for everyone to see fell into a state of confusion.
But it's not surprising that everyone is suspicious. After all, if they hadn't experienced it personally, I'm afraid everyone would think this is impossible to happen.
At the same time, the purple light in the sky became more intense, as spectacular as the scene of the immortal ascending in ancient mythology.
"Yes!
We can live broadcast this phenomenon for everyone to watch together! "
A little girl in the tour group suggested loudly, and everyone immediately took action.
In this era where everyone can start online video sharing, anyone can live broadcast on their personal account to show the real situation.
It is obviously more convincing to directly prove the existence of facts in this way.
"Hello everyone, we are now located in Heilian Mountain. An amazing natural phenomenon suddenly appeared just now. It is really amazing. Please look here..."
The number of viewers in the live broadcast room is growing at an alarming rate.
The number of viewers has reached the highest point in the history of the platform!
The comment section also exploded!
“Oh my God!
This world actually has such a vision! "
"Have you seen the purple mist in the east? Does it look like a dragon?"
"I saw what looked like a unicorn!"
"Am I dazzled? There seems to be a figure flashing inside!"
“I can’t believe it!
We have to let the elders in the family see this miracle, maybe they can restore their health! "
…
Just as people were attracted by the purple light, new news once again caused an uproar on the Internet.
Huaxia News Agency reported: A huge shadow of a palace appeared above the desert in southern China, hundreds of kilometers long.
Nan Gucheng media said: Hundreds of lights and shadows of Buddha appeared in the sky above Taye Temple. Does this mean that the world will be bathed in the light of Buddhism?
东康娱乐发布了一段视频，在海边捕捉到了美妙的人鱼歌声，据说能治愈疾病！
…
面对这些不可思议的事情，网友们经历了一阵狂热之后，竟然难得达成一致地安静下来。
It's not that everyone doesn't want to express their thoughts, but the whole incident has made them feel very confused.
For the first time, they hoped that this was all fake, but all the evidence showed that it really happened.
However, when a new batch of videos began to circulate online, netizens' numb mentality completely collapsed.
This time, it is not only domestic information in China, but also similar reports can be seen in many foreign media.
